Card Q&A.q: Can I ignore digivolution requirements when digivolving by the effect of this card, as long as the cost is 3 or less?
I have a card in my hand with an effect that reads “1 of your Digimon may digivolve into this card in your hand for a digivolution cost of 3.” Can I use this card’ to digivolve into it?

Card Q&A.a:
No, those effects are only active when the digivolution is taking place, which means they reduce the digivolution cost after a player has announced a digivolution. As such, at the time this card's effect is activated, the digivolution cost hasn't been reduced, and you can't choose the card with this card’s effect.
